subject: S15b: landed except tool/canvas registration (waiting on S14 registry)
body:
# S15b done (partial: tool/canvas registration waits on S14)

Commits on claude/naadi-shared: c013b10 (backend, migration 0022), 9197133 (web, gen-space, deploy-gen, e2e, ui_copy), d3af48c (tool core, e2e fix).
CI: runs on the integrate pushes are queued/in progress; matrix result not yet seen (https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions, branch claude/naadi-shared).

## Tests (local stack: own PG/storage/auth containers, seeded)
- api unit+db for generation: 68 pass. Gen-space validation: 10 pass. vitest, lint, typecheck, gen:contracts/gen:requirements: clean.
- e2e smoke (webkit ipad portrait/landscape, webkit phone 390, chromium 1440; --retries=0): 16/16, twice in a row. Includes labelled image, failed, paused (stubbed at API), delete confirm, admin approve -> figure with label caption, prod server "not configured". Screenshots: test-results/screens/15b. Not run: Firefox/full matrix (CI), a real-iPad check.
- Other db tests failing locally and not mine: test_schema_doc, test_live_check (47 tables vs 46), test_seed live check after S20's 0023; test_app_config_api history test not investigated.

## Checklist
- ui_copy keys + REQUIRED keys + defaults regenerated; "generation" added to noHardcodedCopy roots: done. Server responses are codes only.
- RLS in migration 0022; rls test, live_check updated; single head (0017 -> 0022 -> 0023).
- CSP: media-src now includes the Supabase origin (clips). Violet = generated, no lime on Library; lime Publish only in the admin dialog.
- Not done: tutor tool registrations (`agent/tools/generation.py`) and canvas registration: S14 registry/canvas are not on shared. Core is ready in naadi_api/generation/tools.py (prepare_preview, run_tool -> content code, image/video block, generated_media CanvasRef); web: canvas/kinds/generated_media.ts + generation/GeneratedMediaCanvas.tsx, GeneratedBlock.tsx. S14 needs ~10 lines: register_tool("generate_image"/"generate_video", WriteTool(prepare=prepare_preview, apply=run_tool), writes=True, requires_flag="generation"), forward on_event as custom `progress`, and registerCanvasKind(generatedMediaCanvasKind).
- Library "Generated" filter: seg15 mounts <GeneratedLibrary/>; also reachable at /generated.
- Real-person/patient-photo rules are heuristics (no LLM); expect some false negatives/positives.

## Decisions
- LTX-Video licence checked (Lightricks open-weights): allowed free under US$10M revenue, use restrictions, must disclose machine-generated (our label does). Video stays on; NAADI_GEN_VIDEO=0 / video cap 0 disables.
- Only images can be published as chapter figures; clips stay personal. Student-owned chapters are refused.
- ZeroGPU pause is shared (newest unexpired paused row); Space returns base64 JSON via gr.api.
- approve core = naadi_api.generation.approval.approve_generated (for S19's queue).

## Owner steps to enable generation
1. Create the private Space once: `hf repos create arrowassassin/naadi-gen --type space --space-sdk gradio --flavor zero-a10g --private`; set GRADIO_SSR_MODE=false variable. 2. Run workflow deploy-gen (optionally smoke=true, spends quota); first build verifies torch/diffusers pins on ZeroGPU (not tested live). 3. Create a fine-grained HF token with access to that Space only; set as secret HF_GEN_TOKEN on the main Space (scripts/push_space_secrets.sh). 4. `uv run scripts/check_env.py`, then /api/health shows generation ready.
